subject.title: [codex] Add doctor lint for agent model runtime policy drift

question: Should default doctor health classify runtime policies for currently inactive but selectable models as drift, or only warn when an active model reference cannot resolve through the effective policy map?
rationale: The model map is both an allowlist/catalog and the per-model policy surface, so declaring inactive entries stale changes supported configuration semantics and default health output.

options.title: Active references only
options.body: Warn for unresolved active model references while keeping inactive configured model policies valid and silent.

options.title: Strict active-set lint
options.body: Treat every inactive runtime policy as stale, document that restriction, and accept existing multi-model configurations becoming unhealthy.

recommendation.title: Active references only
recommendation.body: Warn for unresolved active model references while keeping inactive configured model policies valid and silent.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent runtime-policy and doctor migration work is the strongest history signal for the intended provider/model/runtime contract.
